readings.Aries: Bold moves suit you. Impulsive ones have a different outcome — know which this is. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Taurus: What feels like stability might be stagnation. It is worth sitting with the discomfort of not knowing. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Gemini: The version of events in your head is more interesting than what actually happened. Check the facts. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Cancer: Safety is the precondition for everything you do best. Build it deliberately. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Leo: You've been playing it safe in a context that rewards exactly the kind of risk you're capable of. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Virgo: You've been useful. You've been reliable. Today something needs you to be present rather than productive. Let this one be easy.
readings.Libra: Not everything can be fair. Some things are just what they are. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: Someone is trying to understand you. Let them try. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Sagittarius: You are searching for a feeling you had once. It is not behind you. It is ahead, in a different form. Let this one be easy.
readings.Capricorn: Your work ethic is not in question. Your relationship to rest is the variable. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Aquarius: Something you've intellectualised needs to be felt. The feeling is safe. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Pisces: The dream you had — not the sleeping one — hasn't been attended to in some time. Return to it. This situation responds well to direct engagement.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
